BiblicalUsage: Hurai is one of David's mighty men, named in the list of the warriors who stood with him. Nothing more is said of him, and his deeds are not recorded. He stands in the list because he stood with David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hurai is remembered because standing with David was itself the deed, and God records loyalty.
RelatedEvents: David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
